rows.note: The only measured sandwich hemispheres (Saturn S-II, two points, gamma 0.22-0.24 at R/rho about 240) have no recoverable Vc; Gonzalez and Patton's SDL 468, which holds the specimens, was not found. The only sphere data cannot be placed on the Vc axis.
rows.settle: SDL 468, or an S-II common-bulkhead construction record (faces, core, depth, radius)

rows.note: No measured point at Vc 0.9 to 2 in any shell form. 018's linear rise from 0.2 to 1 across Vc 0 to 2 is untested there; the SBKF cylinders at Vc 0.3-0.5 already sit above it (0.72-0.87), but as cylinders.
rows.settle: MAINLINE-029's FE at the lead geometry; a sandwich test at Vc about 1

rows.note: Cylinder-to-sphere transfer of a sandwich knockdown has no test behind it. The handbook monocoque ratio at the leads' R/t_eq is 0.30-0.34 (SP-8032/SP-8007), and CR-1457 makes the same split for sandwich (0.20 hemispheres against 0.32-0.36 cylinders).
rows.settle: 029's FE run on both a cylinder and a sphere of the lead's section

rows.note: SBKF Vc comes from lamination theory on stated lamina values with a generic G12 of 0.77 Msi and geometric-mean face and core conventions (range shown as bars: axial-face/axial-shear to softer-core). QUESTIONABLE.
rows.settle: the SBKF laminate stiffness tables, if published

rows.note: CR-1457 Fig. 4.2-3 and Fig. 6.2-3 values are read by eye from page images, by the B and C researchers and independently by this seat; about +/-0.02 in gamma and +/-10% in R/rho.

Not retrieved: FPL 1830 (March and Kuenzi 1957; DTIC 403, FPL 502 from here), Baker AIAA J 1968, the Hexcel summary of 25 Jul 1963, FPL PE-227, Kazimi 1960. Per-specimen geometry and Vc of the pre-1969 cylinders stay unknown.
Measured buckling of the Ariane 5 SYLDA/ISS sandwich shells (Bisagni 2016) is in a restricted paper; Alfano and Bisagni 2017 give only geometry, FE and SP-8007 0.57/0.64.
Brix 1968 (GFP sandwich domes under external pressure) and Anderson 1966 (Georgia Tech, spherical sandwich shell) are unread leads; either may hold the only sandwich-dome test series.
CR-1457 cites SP-8007 (Sept 1965) for a 0.90 lateral-pressure factor; the 1968 SP-8007 text read here gives 0.56 with no supporting data.
